translation: Qiao is that from which the Yang Qiao is generated; it is the Shenmai point. 'Above the Qiao and below the xi' is the Chengjin point (BL56), that is, the center of the calf in the place that is hollowed on the outside. It is where the vessel-qi of Taiyang issues; needling is forbidden [there], and one only looks [for] where, in the center of the two calves, there is a blood-luo full and exuberant and then punctures it to let blood.
